title: 2026 pre-charged equipment 100t-CO2e registration and quota-authorisation QA

sources.title: Import, export or manufacture equipment pre-charged with F gas

facts.source_fact: Importers of pre-charged HFC equipment into Great Britain may need F-gas service registration and quota authorisations or delegations.
Pre-charged equipment includes equipment contained within other products, including vehicles with air-conditioning.
Registration and quota-authorisation requirements apply at 100 tonnes CO2e or more of imported HFCs in a calendar year.
After registration, the organisation uses its organisation ID when arranging authorisations or delegations.
Quota holders or authorisation managers grant use through the official quota service.
Transactions must be completed before 31 December to count for the same calendar year.
Enough authorisations or delegations must be present before 31 December to cover goods placed on the market during that year.
Unused authorisations and delegations can be carried over to the next calendar year.
A declaration of conformity is used to certify that HFCs in relevant pre-charged equipment are accounted for within the quota system.
Quota coverage evidence does not itself establish operating emissions from the equipment.
